800.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

<!-- DM31:M31 -->

Parent: [DigitalMate v3.1 production server migration](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/737). Stable task ID: `DM31-M31`.

**Outcome:** New room command owner handles room.create/invite/remove/ask_agents/turns/project/messages/reset, discussion.follow/room.discussion.follow, reactions and thread modifications through Store transactions.

**Owner:** Backend / Session Store. **Batch:** P2: business modules and deep Harness parity. **Size:** 1 working day; existing leaves reused, prerequisites excluded.

**Not responsible for:**
- No new social-room UI or agent-selection algorithm; reuse existing room rules.
- No EngineService/Bridge/WorkSwarm daemon wrapper or shared old session database.
- Room/discussion/member metadata is a Gateway/application projection; Message/Session/Run records and history come only from public Store/AS operations. No room-owned second transcript or terminal writer.

**Frozen main:** `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`. **Architecture reference:** `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`. Implementation PR base: current `main`; reconcile intervening changes against the source map. No validation-branch merge or implementation claimed here.

### Design Ideas

**Concrete transfer / deliverable:** To achieve New room command owner handles room.create/invite/remove/ask_agents/turns/project/messages/reset, discussion.follow/room.discussion.follow, reactions and thread modifications through Store transactions, adapt `harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/engine_service.py::EngineService._handle_request` into `server/agent_service/backend/rooms.py::RoomCommands; server/agent_service/session_store/rooms.py::RoomRecords`. Preserve the stated algorithms/behavior and align the named public contracts; remove the listed old authority and I/O.

**Target component / proposed path / published interface:** server/agent_service/backend/rooms.py::RoomCommands; server/agent_service/session_store/rooms.py::RoomRecords

**Source evidence:**
- Frozen main [harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/engine_service.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/engine_service.py) — `EngineService._handle_request`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.
- Frozen main [harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/room_discussions.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/room_discussions.py) — `follow_discussion`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.
- Frozen main [harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/engine_conversations.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/engine_conversations.py) — `register.modify`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.
- Frozen main [harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/room_reactions.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/room_reactions.py) — `react_as_person, react_as_agent`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.

**Reuse classification:** Selective adaptation of named behavior and tests; new owner/contract implementation where legacy authority cannot be retained. Reference implementations are review inputs, not a whole-directory copy.

**Preserve:**
- Membership and write-authority checks
- Pagination cursor, discussion-root provenance
- Refuse deletion until active task stop confirmed
- Archive/pin/rename/read state

**Remove or redirect authority / I/O:**
- Room mutations in compatibility transport
- Private EngineStore hooks as cross-component calls

**Writable boundary:**
- server/agent_service/backend/rooms.py
- server/agent_service/session_store/rooms.py
- tests/server/agent_service/st/test_room_commands.py

**Read-only sources:** the source list above until an explicitly listed compatibility delegate is changed in this PR. Other owners' public interfaces are dependencies, not permission to edit their private modules. Original user checkout and other session worktrees remain read-only.

**Shared-type and state owners:** A01 owns core M/S/R/error public types; A14 owns hook/attempt/reservation contract coordination; Session Store owner exclusively serializes schema, admission, context, receipt and accounting records; Host lifecycle owner serializes dispatch/Stop/finalization. Request changes through their owning issues. This task owns only its declared module and tests.

**Hard blocked-by:** [DM31-M15](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/785)

**Blocks:** [DM31-M34](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/805), [DM31-M47](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/837)

**May proceed in parallel:** [DM31-M06](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/775), [DM31-M07](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/776), [DM31-M26](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/778), [DM31-M08](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/779)

**Integration gate (not a blocker on independent preparation):** Run affected cross-component UT/ST on the combined main head after each batch; independent QA proves the default public path and relevant unchanged-phone cases. A fake may not replace the owner whose behavior is under test.

**Rollback / persisted-format impact:** Keep compatibility reads and stable identities. For new persisted fields, declare the encoding/version and old-reader behavior with the Store owner before activation; unsupported downgrade fails closed. Before switching traffic, fence old writers and prove compatible readers. Rolling back new admissions never replays an unknown effect, restores legacy execution, changes a committed terminal, or discards unsettled accounting.

**Accepted scope and unresolved decisions:** - Session Store revisioned room/message contract

### Test Design and Test Plan

All commands below are **planned acceptance**, except explicitly identified existing characterization commands. None was run as product verification by the planning session.

**Inputs and observable assertions:**
**Normal:** Create room, invite agent, set follows, paginate older messages, pin/rename/archive/unarchive thread and reset; snapshots preserve declared revisions.

**Failure:** Remove a busy agent or delete active thread is rejected; foreign discussion root or cursor cannot read another room.

**Concurrency:** Concurrent follow/unfollow and room reset use expected revision; one write wins and the other returns conflict without lost membership.


**Existing tests, new UT/ST, participants and substitutes:**
**Existing:** - **Command:** PYTHONPATH=harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src:harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests python -m unittest discover -s harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests -p 'test_engine_room_membership.py' -v

  **Participants:** Real legacy source/component, temporary storage and suite-controlled model/runtime/provider doubles; not evidence of new implementation.

- **Command:** PYTHONPATH=harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src:harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests python -m unittest discover -s harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests -p 'test_room_reactions.py' -v

  **Participants:** Real legacy source/component, temporary storage and suite-controlled model/runtime/provider doubles; not evidence of new implementation.

- **Command:** PYTHONPATH=harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src:harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests python -m unittest discover -s harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests -p 'test_engine_conversations.py' -v

  **Participants:** Real legacy source/component, temporary storage and suite-controlled model/runtime/provider doubles; not evidence of new implementation.


**Planned:** **Command:** python -m unittest -v tests.server.agent_service.st.test_room_commands

**Participants:** Real new owner and public proxy, real extracted validation/state-transition leaves; temporary Store and controlled external dependencies.


**Status:** Not run; new suite is planned.


**Architecture and E2E obligations:** Run the relevant AR01–AR10 checks against the migrated module, with both legal and deliberately violating fixtures. Owner-boundary ST uses real public proxies and real temporary persistence; providers may be controlled and must be named. Independent QA runs affected unchanged-client scenarios when this capability enters the candidate assembly. No device pass is inferred from UT/ST.

**Required evidence:** exact base/head; source/target symbol diff; public API and state-owner map; command and exit status; distinct test count and skips; fixture inputs and expected/actual outcomes; real participants versus substitutes; before/after production dispatch trace; retained original failures; planned/unrun/blocked gates. For a migration, include M→S/R→Host operation→authoritative record identity and a negative bypass/reconnection result. No credentials or raw user content.

**Completion checklist:**
- [ ] The observable result above is demonstrated by its normal and meaningful failure/concurrency cases.
- [ ] For migrated behavior, the default configured production call path now reaches the new owner. A preparation/contract/QA task instead delivers its exact stated artifact and does not claim a production switch.
- [ ] The old entry is removed or delegates only through published proxies; no duplicate authority, dual write or silent old-executor fallback remains for this migrated capability.
- [ ] Reintroducing direct provider/storage calls or reconnecting the old executor makes the appropriate gate fail; the legal fixture still passes.
- [ ] The extension interface, owner, exact test command and migration inventory are updated for subsequent feature developers.
- [ ] Independent integration evidence is linked; task closure alone does not close the master architecture or main-behavior gate.

**Coverage:** room.create, room.messages, discussion.follow, room.discussion.follow, thread.modify, room membership. **Architecture rules / accepted contracts:** ADR-0001, ADR-0004, AR01, AR04, AR06, AR09.

Research: [main capabilities](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/main-capabilities.md), [architecture evidence](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/architecture-evidence.md), [CI and QA](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/gates-qa.md), [migration developer guide](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/developer-guide.md).

### Checklist

- [x] Searched for related issues.
- [x] Included reproduction steps, the tested build and screenshots.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

When a Files request is denied at submission after agent read access has been revoked, DigitalMate displays a generic retry message. The Bridge returns FORBIDDEN before creating a task.

1. In the isolated Files provider, grant agent read access and read a file from the App.
2. Revoke access and ask the App to read the same file again.

**Actual.** The request is denied and the App displays “这次操作未完成，请稍后重试”.

**Expected.** The request remains denied. The App explains that file access was revoked and tells the user how to restore it before retrying.

### Detailed Environment Information Description

HarmonyOS API 23 emulator with OpenHarmony 6.1.0.115. Native App connected to an isolated Files/MCP fixture.

### Additional Information

E2E case PERM-01 in PR #670. Validation tracker #565.

A later run exercised denial at the tool layer and showed recovery guidance. After reauthorization, the file content and revision matched the original read. Provider UI revocation and the ordinary WorkSwarm path were outside that run. See the [execution record](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/9f4ea7b1833cc6ef11a460a8a552cd71d36b1503/tests/e2e/results/e4-565-20261106/verification.json). Related error guidance discussion in #359.

### Version Information

DigitalMate 0.1.0, build 10008 (debug).

### Screenshots / Recordings

![Generic App error after the Bridge denied the revoked request](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/a7706055f99faa70e6ff72249b31c49bf62f3d16/tests/e2e/results/e4-565-20261106/perm01-denied.png)

### Checklist

- [x] Searched for related issues.
- [x] Included reproduction steps, the tested build and screenshots.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

The App removes text already visible in a streaming reply when the underlying model stream ends in an error.

1. Send one message in the native App.
2. Pause the model stream after it has delivered visible text.
3. Abort the paused stream and wait for the task to fail.

**Actual.** The retest showed 71 characters before the abort. The same task moved from running to failed, and the App showed an error in place of the partial reply. The Bridge recorded one submission.

**Expected.** The conversation shows that the task failed and keeps the text the user already received.

### Detailed Environment Information Description

HarmonyOS API 26 emulator. The native App connected to a local Bridge and WorkSwarm with a scripted model for fault injection.

### Additional Information

E2E case SILENCE-01 in PR #713. Validation tracker #565.

The terminal failure reproduced in the retest. The resume branch completed in a separate run. See the [E5 run guide](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/50bc9fe7e55b28455b457a7d22e6b6e24353e15e/tests/e2e/workflow/guides/E5.md) and the [retest record](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/50bc9fe7e55b28455b457a7d22e6b6e24353e15e/tests/e2e/results/e5-565-20261106/verification.json).

### Version Information

### Checklist

- [x] Searched for related issues.
- [x] Included reproduction steps, the tested build and screenshots.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

A model timeout before the first response chunk produces a generic failure in the App. WorkSwarm reports a first-chunk timeout and the Bridge record reports the failure code as unknown.

1. Send one message in the native App.
2. Hold the model stream before its first chunk until WorkSwarm times out.
3. Inspect the chat error, then retry once from the original task.

**Actual.** The App displays “回复失败” with a generic retry message. The retry completes the original task. The Bridge records one submission and one retry.

**Expected.** The App identifies the timeout and offers a retry for the original task.

### Detailed Environment Information Description

HarmonyOS API 26 emulator. The native App connected to a local Bridge and WorkSwarm with a scripted model for fault injection.

### Additional Information

E2E case TIMEOUT-01 in PR #713. Validation tracker #565.

The missing timeout message reproduced in the retest. The final conversation contained one original prompt, the successful reply and one historical error reply. See the [retest record](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/50bc9fe7e55b28455b457a7d22e6b6e24353e15e/tests/e2e/results/e5-565-20261106/verification.json). Related error guidance discussion in #359.

### Version Information

DigitalMate 0.1.0, build 10008 (debug).

### Screenshots / Recordings

![Generic failure after a confirmed first-chunk timeout](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/50bc9fe7e55b28455b457a7d22e6b6e24353e15e/tests/e2e/results/e5-565-20261106/timeout-error.png)

884.author: huben0423-hw
884.body:
### Checklist

- [x] 已检索相关 issue，未发现报告同类前缀缓存异常的条目。
- [x] 已附复现步骤与所报数据的截图。

### 🐞 问题详细描述

服务端前缀缓存疑似在一个前缀几乎未变化的请求上被完全失效，导致该请求被从头重新计算，而没有复用已缓存的前缀。

**复现步骤**
1. 在对话 `chat-6` 中依次发起请求，直到第 5 次请求（输入 59,019 tokens）。
2. 逐次查看每次请求的缓存统计（见下表）。
3. 将第 5 次与第 4 次对比：第 5 次仅多出 318 个输入 tokens，且与第 4 次相隔 17 秒。

| # | 输入 tokens | 命中缓存 | 未命中 | 单次命中率 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 22,610 | 17,920 | 4,690 | 79.26% |
| 2 | 28,913 | 22,400 | 6,513 | 77.47% |
| 3 | 52,261 | 28,672 | 23,589 | 54.86% |
| 4 | 58,701 | 52,096 | 6,605 | 88.75% |
| 5 | 59,019 | 128 | 58,891 | 0.22% |
| 合计 | 221,504 | 121,216 | 100,288 | 54.72% |

**实际现象。** 第 5 次请求仅报告 128 个缓存命中 tokens：单次命中率 0.22%，未命中 58,891 tokens —— 约占整个会话未命中总量（100,288）的 59%。内部标记显示前缀并未变化（`stable_prefix_changed` 为 false；`system_prompt` 与 `tools` 均未变），但该请求仍被从头计算。这一次调用把 `chat-6` 的整体命中率从约 75%（其余各次）拉低到 54.7%（合计 54.72%）。

**期望行为。** 在前缀几乎未变、距第 4 次请求仅 17 秒的情况下，应当复用已预热的前缀缓存。复用第 4 次约 88% 的命中率，可让 `chat-6` 整体回到约 78–79%，与全局约 80% 的命中率相符，而不是从零重新计算。

### 环境信息详细说明

DigitalMate 移动端 App（v0.1.9）；截图时间为北京时间 2026-11-08 00:55，对话 `chat-6` 共 5 次模型调用。设备型号：huawei nova 16；操作系统：HarmonyOS。

### 补充信息

数据来自所附截图中的缓存/用量统计。说明：
- 第 3 次请求新增约 2.3 万 tokens（消息量从约 12k 增至约 37k）；此处首次未命中属正常冷启动（非异常）。
- 第 5 次与第 3 次请求合计约占 `chat-6` 未命中总量的 82%。
- `chat-6` 仅 5 次调用，单次异常会被整体比例放大；不应仅据此判断为长期低命中率。

建议排查：
- 对比第 4 次与第 5 次请求的前缀差异。
- 检查缓存过期 / 淘汰行为。
- 检查其他对话是否出现相同的整段未命中。

### 版本信息

v0.1.9

### 截图 / 录屏

![chat-6 前缀缓存第 5 次请求仅命中 128 token（单次命中率 0.22%），并含 5 次调用明细](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/9f80a50bc8a7c481717f472ed8b26ebb31157799/.github/issue-assets/884/prefix-cache-128-token.jpg)
884.title: [Bug]: 偶现前缀缓存异常失效：前缀几乎未变却仅命中 128 token（单次命中率 0.22%）

896.author: huben0423-hw
896.body:
## 现象与证据
- 请求时间：2026-11-08 00:28:51，整条请求耗时 300.9s。
- 工具执行共 150.6s，其中 4 次 bash 调用就占了 129.6s（占工具总时间 86%）。
- 明细：R17 = 66.2s、R14 = 28.9s、R15 = 23.4s、R24 = 11.1s。
- 数据来源：step_breakdown_tool_calls.csv；events.jsonl 中 tool-call 到 tool-result 的时间差。

## 影响
- 单条 bash 命令耗时可达 66s，且期间无超时控制、无进度反馈，用户长时间看不到任何反馈，感知为“卡死”，严重拖垮整条请求体验。

## 期望
- 为 bash / 长命令增加可配置超时与心跳进度。
- 超过 5s 输出阶段性进度并允许中断。
- 超长命令支持拆分执行。

## 标签
performance / tooling / P1
